title: I. Experimental researches in electricity.—Nineteenth series
venue: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London
significance: Reports magnetically induced rotation of light polarization (discovered 1845), the first evidence linking light and electromagnetism; Faraday rotators underlie optical isolators and circulators.

title: VIII. A dynamical theory of the electromagnetic field
venue: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London
significance: Twenty original field equations; derives an electromagnetic wave equation and concludes light is an electromagnetic disturbance.

era: E0 1842-1959 foundations: guided light, field theory, waveguides, maser
title: Elektromagnetische Wellen an dielektrischen Drähten
significance: First theory of electromagnetic waves guided by a dielectric cylinder (Hondros and Debye), underlying optical fiber mode analysis.

title:

significance: Wave theory of whispering-gallery propagation (St Paul's Cathedral), origin of the whispering-gallery-mode concept used for optical microresonators.

dri: Charles H. Townes; James P. Gordon; H. J. Zeiger
